- **Builder:** Bulinski Effect Pedals
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** Bass-focused fuzz designed for thick low-end response.

- Fuzz
- Volume
- Tone
- Gain

The available database record describes hand-wired construction and suitability for both active and passive bass pickups.

The documented goal is a powerful, gritty fuzz that maintains bass clarity and low-frequency weight.

- 9V DC, center-negative.

The available source set does not establish a detailed circuit family, transistor set, or definitive production version, so those fields remain intentionally unspecified.

1. Made For Bass database: https://www.madeforbass.com/bass-effects-database/

The Made For Bass database documents RC Bass Fuzz as a bass-focused fuzz with **Fuzz, Volume, Tone, Gain** controls, hand-wired construction, suitability for active and passive bass pickups, and 9V DC centre-negative power. The source describes a thick, gritty fuzz designed to retain low-end clarity. Exact transistor and diode details remain undocumented in the cited source.

Source: https://www.madeforbass.com/bass-effects-database/
